note: The upload TLV supplies an attacker-controlled IMAP APPEND body and size.
The same TLV length is installed as the declared upload size.

code: result = Curl_urldecode(data, begin, end - begin, &imap->mailbox, NULL, TRUE);
note: The URL path selects a mailbox, making the transfer enter the APPEND path when upload is enabled.
APPEND is initiated using the mailbox and attacker-controlled upload length; the server continuation then causes the upload body to be streamed.
The upload callback writes the attacker-controlled body into curl's provided upload buffer during the IMAP APPEND transfer.
